errors.network: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Easy there! Try again in a few minutes.

respect.title: Respect, always.
respect.body: No insults, threats or hate. Behind every profile is someone you might run into at the cafeteria.

consent.title: Consent comes first.
consent.body: A "no", a silence or a block must be respected. No sexual images, ever. If someone makes you uncomfortable, report them: it's anonymous.

discretion.title: What happens here stays here.
discretion.body: No shared screenshots, no outing. Be yourself: your photos, your first name, your real age.

charter.legal: By accepting, you also accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and acknowledge reading the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

name.title: What's your name?
name.lead: Your first name, as your friends use it. No last name here.
name.label: First name
name.invalid: Only letters, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes (40 characters max).

birth.title: Your date of birth
birth.lead: Atomes is for adults only. We show your age, never your date of birth.
birth.label: Date of birth
birth.confirmBody: Your date of birth can't be changed afterwards.

gender.title: You are…
gender.lead: This helps us show your profile to the right people.
gender.label: Gender
gender.pronounsHelp: Shown on your profile if you add them.

seeking.title: What are you looking for?
seeking.lead: You can change your mind any time in settings.
seeking.label: Mode

friends.label: Friends
friends.description: Campus friends, a sports buddy, a gaming squad.

audience.title: Who do you want to see?
audience.consentBody: The gender of the people you want to meet can reveal your sexual orientation. Under the GDPR this is sensitive data: we only use it to suggest profiles, it is never displayed, never shared and never exported.
audience.consentLabel: I agree that Atomes uses the genders I'm looking for, which is sensitive data, to suggest profiles in Love mode.
audience.consentHelp: You can withdraw this consent any time in settings: Love mode is then switched off, Friends mode stays available.
audience.withoutConsentNote: Without this consent, you use Atomes in Friends mode.
audience.interestedInLabel: In Love mode, you want to see
audience.friendsOnlyLead: In Friends mode, everyone can come across you. Just pick an age range.

photos.title: Your photos
photos.lead: At least 2, up to 6. The first one is the one people see first.
photos.minimum: {count, plural, one {# more photo} other {# more photos}} to continue.
photos.tips: Your face clearly visible, natural light, no sunglasses on every shot. Photos are checked by the team before anyone sees them.
photos.failed: This file is not a usable photo.
photos.unsupported: This format isn't supported. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.
photos.cropHelp: Drag to move, use the slider to zoom.
photos.altTextHelp: Read by screen readers. Example: "Me hiking above Lake Annecy".

prompts.title: Three prompts
prompts.lead: Questions to get the conversation going. 200 characters each: make it count.
prompts.missing: Pick three different prompts and answer each one.

interests.title: Your interests
interests.lead: Between 3 and 10. We use them to show what you have in common.
interests.minimum: {count, plural, one {# more interest} other {# more interests}} to continue.

campus.title: Your campus and class
campus.lead: Your school comes from your email. Just tell us when you graduate.
campus.onCampus: I study on the Lyon campus.
campus.student: I'm a student, not a staff member.
campus.declarationsHelp: Atomes is only for students of the campus. A profile that isn't can be reported and removed.

done.title: All set, {name}.
done.lead: Your photos are being checked. Meanwhile, your profile is created and you can look around.
done.photosPending: {count, plural, one {# photo being checked} other {# photos being checked}}
done.passkeyBody: Save a passkey (Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello) to sign back in without waiting for a code.
done.passkeyFailed: The passkey couldn't be saved. You can try again in settings.

underage.title: Come back when you're 18.
underage.body: Atomes is for adults only. Your account has been deleted and no data was kept, except an encrypted fingerprint of your address until you turn 18.
underage.help: If you need to talk to someone, 3018 (online harassment) and Fil Santé Jeunes (0 800 235 236) are free and anonymous.
